arStrings.szText:
Shapeshifting into a new form uses a free Skill and grants an additional bonus for {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} seconds:
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Werewolf{/c} uses {c_important}Blood Howl{/c} and grants {c_random}[SF_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Werebear{/c} uses {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} and grants {c_random}[SF_5 * 100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Human{/c} uses {c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} and grants {c_random}[SF_9 * 100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed
